reviewed.baselines: T1 SDK002 6ee61d84 (mq7c5y3r, drv x3vml5lm) and KC002 87040958 (8razrjmk, drv c08zipmd)

verdict: BOUND. The T2 SDK is the reviewed source set b70540ba built with the SDK002 recipe plus the seven new inputs. The T2 KC is KC002 with only the PDM1SPIHID bundle replaced. The KC's PDM1SPIHID code is the T2 SDK, and it contains the PDM1SPITrackpad class (host note H1). All 45 frozen T1 transport and enumeration functions compiled identically to SDK002. Every other difference is explained by the source change or by KC layout.

checks.recipe: build-child.nix differs from build-enum-rev002.nix only in its inputs file (sdk-build-inputs-001.json), names and the 23-entry checked list. It adds PDM1SPIHIDChild.inc, PDM1SPITrackpad.cpp/.h, m1tp_child_policy.c/.h, child_state.h and the private trackpad_reference.h, which is copied from runs/m1-desktop-010/trackpad-child-reference-001. sdk-build-inputs-001.json equals source-manifest.json (23 names and hashes). build-kc.nix differs from build-kc-rev002.nix only in importing build-child.nix as the PDM1SPIHID replacement.
checks.derivations: SDK wy6zvlhv versus x3vml5lm: only the source derivation (a8jlz99j for fagvb5jx), names, output and postPatch. postPatch is exactly 23 'sha256sum -c' lines equal to the manifest and nothing else. KC yv7v0mdb versus c08zipmd: only the SDK input derivation and output. buildPhase is byte-equal after substituting the SDK path, with exactly one -kext line using it.
checks.immutable_source: sgqj849n src/Kernel/Extensions/PDM1SPIHID holds exactly 23 files equal to the manifest, set b70540ba.
checks.binary: ARM64 MH_BUNDLE with libSystem only. Imports 372 -> 378, exactly root's lists. Added: kOSBooleanFalse, IOService::isInactive and six base virtuals. The bind table puts IOHIDDevice::init, IOService::probe, IOService::terminate, IOService::getWorkLoop, IOHIDDevice::handleStart and IOHIDDevice::newLocationIDNumber at 0x10F10-0x115E8, inside __ZTV15PDM1SPITrackpad (0x10c98-0x11720), so they are the child's inherited vtable slots and the child does not override getWorkLoop (M4). Removed: IOHIDDevice::handleOpen and newUserClient. Both classes now override them, and -fapple-kext qualified super calls go through the superclass vtable. The disassembly of PDM1SPITrackpad::handleOpen loads __ZTV11IOHIDDevice from GOT 0x10010 and does blr through slot 0x628, so no capability is lost. PDM1SPITrackpad has its metaclass, vtable and every declared method; there is no getWorkLoop or async-report symbol.
checks.frozen_code: Address-normalized disassembly versus SDK002: all 45 frozen functions are instruction-identical (startHardware, enumerate, enumerateTrackpad, waitResponse, receive, preserveTrackpadEnumeration, handleStart, all m1tp_/m1kbd_/dlsp_ helpers, PDM1KeyboardHW). The only changed functions are the patched parent methods (init, probe, start, poll, publishCounters, fail, quiesce, handleStop, stop, disposeTransport, free), the metaclass/alloc/D0 for the larger object, and the stubs. 57 functions are new.
checks.kc: 50 entries in the same order. 47 are byte-identical. PDM1SPIHID (same vmaddr; __TEXT 49152 -> 65536): __text, stubs, stub_helper, cstring, text __const and unwind_info are byte-identical to SDK 72ba1228, with only linked data differing (got 33, mod_init 12, const 3444, kalloc_type 11, la_symbol_ptr 173, data 16 bytes). Against T1 6ee61d84 the sizes differ. PDKeyStore, the next and last entry, moves by exactly 0x8000 in vmaddr and fileoff. Its only __TEXT differences are 18 words in its own load commands (no code words). Its 23 __DATA_CONST differences are all pointers +0x8000, and its 3 __DATA differences carry 0x8000 in the upper 32-bit half. The kernel's 19 differing __TEXT bytes all lie in the KC load-command area (0xcc1-0x235c, which ends at 0x23a8). Strings: pdm1trackpadchild, PDM1TrackpadChildStateV1, PDM1SPIInterfaceID and TEARDOWN_DEFERRED are new; pdm1trackpadenum is kept; 'PDSerialHID: listening' and pddartsurvey are absent.
checks.build_log: runs/m1-desktop-010/trackpad-child-sdk-build001.log: 0 errors. Compiler warnings 17 + 20 + 20 (the extra TU is PDM1SPITrackpad.cpp), plus the Nix HEAD-ref line. Outside the IOLib.h/cs_blobs.h header macros, the only warnings are the existing OSDefineMetaClassAndStructors typed-allocator expansion at PDM1SPITrackpad.cpp:8 and PDM1SPIHID.cpp:14 (3 each, the same family as SDK005 and T1). None are in the lifecycle, routing or policy code.

notes.text: The KC grows by 32768 bytes and moves PDKeyStore. The T2 packet must bind this KC hash and its fileset as a whole; PDKeyStore's bytes cannot be compared to KC002's except through this explained shift.

The private reference header is an absolute-path input under runs/. Its bytes end up in the SDK and KC, where the acquired descriptor would be anyway. Keep the header and descriptor.bin out of Git, as descriptor-reference.json says.

scope: Read-only: recipes, .drv text, immutable source, llvm-nm/objdump on both bundles, KC fileset entries and segments, build log. No builds, edits, SSH or hardware.
